entry.title: I Built a Tool That Converts React + Vite to Next.js — Here’s Why (and How You Can Use It)
entry.summary:
I Built a Tool That Converts React + Vite to Next.js — Here’s Why (and How You Can Use It)
Hey Devs I love working with React + Vite. It's fast, modern, and super developer-friendly. But every time I had to move a project to Next.js for SEO, SSR, or routing reasons… it was a mess. Manually migrating a React + Vite project to Next.js means: Replacing react-router with App Router or Pages Router Restructuring folders (/pages or /app) Managing "use client" everywhere Fixing hooks and providers Losing precious hours (and patience) So I built something to help. ViteToNext.AI
A tool that automatically transforms your React + Vite project into a working Next.js App Router structure. Analyzes your routes, layouts, and components using AST parsing Converts React Router to app/-based routing Preserves your layouts and providers Adds "use client" where needed Lets you preview and export your Next.js-ready code (ZIP or GitHub) You can try it here:
👉 https://vitetonext.codebypaki.online Free plan for small projects (up to 10 routes) Agency plan for full migration and GitHub integration No login required to test basic features. Because developers shouldn’t have to waste time on tedious, error-prone rewrites. This tool started as a weekend project for myself… and it quickly became something useful for others. If it helps you save time, I’d love to hear it. Support for Pages Router Auto internationalization (next-i18next, next-intl) Provider detection and wrapping More layout heuristics If you’ve tried the tool — or you’ve done this migration manually before — I’d love to hear your story. Ping me in the comments or reach out via the chat in the app. Thanks for reading
And happy refactoring
